title: Twister

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Steelbird Twister delivers breezy open-air freedom for scenic cruising and city exploration. Featuring a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan architecture at a featherweight 1121g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ISI, ECE 22.05 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~95 dB aero profile. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Light open face with flip visor for commuters.

variants.title: Steelbird Twister Black
variants.description: The Steelbird Twister is a benchmark Open Face helmet crafted in Global Certified. Built around Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability, it is engineered specifically for Intermediate Oval ergonomics. Optimized for urban commuters and retro cruisers, offering lightweight agility, wide peripheral vision, and step-through convenience. Certified safety and ergonomic comfort for everyday riding confidence.

product_details.description: Light open face with flip visor for commuters.

variants.introduction: Positioned in Steelbird's Open Face lineup, the Twister brings Indian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ISI, ECE 22.05 track safety.
variants.story:
The Steelbird Twister represents Steelbird's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~95 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Steelbird Twister delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
variants.finish_profile: Steelbird Twister Black (gloss finish) — Treated with a mirror-finish deep gloss clearcoat that repels road grime and simplifies bug cleanup.
variants.editorial_note: Steelbird Twister in Steelbird Twister Black. A stylish, low-profile open-face helmet pairing vintage roadster flair with certified multi-density cranial protection for warm-weather cruising.
variants.fitment_notes: Sculpted for Intermediate Oval head shapes with low-profile ear pockets and open-cranial comfort lining. Minimal break-in required with instant pressure-free crown seating.
